identity.title: An ALMA+ACA measurement of the shock in the Bullet Cluster

paper_type_evidence.quote: Our analysis technique relies on the reconstruction of a parametric model for the SZ signal by directly and jointly fitting data from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) and Atacama Compact Array (ACA) in Fourier space.

evidence.quote: At the redshift of the Bullet Cluster ($z = 0.296$), $1\ensuremath{''}$ corresponds to a physical scale of $4.41~\mathrm{kpc}$.

question.value: What are the Mach number and electron-ion equilibration behaviour of the western shock in the Bullet Cluster, measured from the thermal SZ pressure jump with ALMA+ACA plus X-ray priors?

evidence.quote: We aim to characterize the shock properties using deep, high-resolution interferometric SZ effect observations in combination with priors from an independent X-ray analysis.

analysis_steps.goal: Determine shock front geometry from Chandra

method.value: Fit hyperbolic step-function model to X-ray image by minimizing variance in angular sectors; MAP model adopted

evidence.quote: The model is assumed to be simply given by a step function in which the discontinuity has a hyperbolic shape.

assumptions.value: Axially-symmetric front, merger axis in plane of sky, symmetric curvature in LoS and PoS

evidence.quote: we consider the curvature of the front to be symmetric with respect to the line-of-sight and the plane-of-sky direction.

analysis_steps.goal: Forward-model SZ signal and fit visibilities

method.value: Integrate 3D pressure model (power-law downstream, gNFW upstream) along LoS, apply SZ spectrum with relativistic correction, FFT and sample at uv points, fit jointly ALMA+ACA

evidence.quote: The SZ model image is then Fourier transformed and sampled to the position of the sparse interferometric data.

why_this_method.value: Fit in uv space to avoid CLEAN deconvolution biases and missing flux issues

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: SZ-only shock geometry and Mach number were unconstrained, so X-ray priors were adopted

evidence.quote: the parameters defining its geometry are heavily degenerate, and the small extent of the ALMA+ACA field of view does not allow for meaningful constraints.

limitations_admitted.value: Systematics from cluster geometry and complex post-shock gas distribution; model does not capture X-ray morphology

evidence.quote: Our analysis is however limited by systematics related to the overall cluster geometry and the complexity of the post-shock gas distribution.
